theorems.statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (u : Euclid m → Euclid k) (δ C₀ : ℝ) (s : ℕ → Euclid m) (t : ℕ → Euclid k) (lams : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 δ) → fderiv ℝ u 0 = 0 → (∀ i, 0 < lams i) → Tendsto s atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∃ w : Euclid m, ‖w‖ ≤ C₀ ∧ s i + lams i • w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) δ ∧ ‖u (s i + lams i • w) - t i‖ ≤ C₀ * lams i) → ∃ (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (b : Euclid k), StrictMono σ ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) R, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => (lams (σ i))⁻¹ • (u (s (σ i) + lams (σ i) • w) - t (σ i))) w) ∧ ∀ R ε : ℝ, 0 < R → 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ i in atTop, ∀ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid m) R, ‖(lams (σ i))⁻¹ • (u (s (σ i) + lams (σ i) • w) - t (σ i)) - b‖ < ε ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => (lams (σ i))⁻¹ • (u (s (σ i) + lams (σ i) • w) - t (σ i))) w‖ < ε
